lines: A vague resolution
No matter how I struggle
If it's a simple question with an answer
Heads, tails
Using it all up
Practicing drifting apart, over and over
Wanting to see you is finite — the habit of checking, so as not to break it, ends up confirming it
Don't hate me — just save me already
Caught up in the spiral again
I can't even think about you anymore
Spring too
Disinfection too
I want to bring it all to an end
Don't use artificial intelligence to try to hold me back
Don't go scattering easy answers around
Though there's no need to swim, no wounds either, somehow I take the breath I learned to take
I'll drown first — if that could erase it all, then anywhere, just far away
I say pretty things, still pricing their worth as I do
Come here, come here, come here — why
Even though by tomorrow I'll have forgotten it all
Picking through nothing but your flaws
Crawling under the trap of isolation
Drowning myself in deep scheming
Laughing with a cool face
Then quietly letting tears fall — why
Why, when I don't want to cross over
It's unfair, it's unfair
Telling the pain to fly away
Enough already, enough already
If I can't become your meaning
Don't steal the updraft to try to hold me back
Don't hand me possibility so easily
Though there's no need to swim, no wounds either, somehow I take the breath I learned to take
I'll drown first — if that could erase it all, then anywhere, just far away
I say pretty things, still pricing their worth as I do
Come here, come here, come here — why
Even though by tomorrow I'll have forgotten it all
What am I resisting
What can I hate
Don't leave it in someone else's hands
Though there's no need to swim, no wounds either, somehow I take the breath I learned to take
I'll drown first — if I could erase it all with my fingers
Then anywhere, just far away
I say pretty things, still pricing their worth as I do
Come here, come here, come here — why
Even though by tomorrow I'll have slipped away from it
Even if I fit the mold, I want to keep fighting it (tonight too, I'll melt into the water and rest)
Even if there's punishment, I won't turn around (I just want to swim carefully, simply)
Even if I fit the mold, I want to keep struggling (tonight too, melting into the water, goodnight)
Even covered in mud, let me believe — I want to love a different self
